notes.title: DreamHack Dallas 2025
notes.content:
[b]Live from DreamHack Dallas 2025 – Developer Hangout & Gameplay Showcase![/b]

Join us all weekend for a special live stream straight from the show floor at [b]DreamHack Dallas 2025[/b]!

The dev team behind [i]The Colony 2044[/i] will be [b]playing the game live[/b], chatting with players, and answering your burning questions. Whether you've played the game before or just curious, this is your chance to connect directly with the creators and learn more about the world, mechanics, and upcoming features.

[b]What to expect:[/b]

[list]
[*]Live developer gameplay sessions   
[*]Behind-the-scenes stories  
[*]Sneak peeks at what's coming next  
[*]Real-time community interaction  
[/list]

Tune in, hang out, and be part of the conversation!

[b]Streaming all weekend from DreamHack Dallas – don’t miss it![/b]

notes.title: DreamHack Dallas 2025
notes.content:
[h3]The Colony 2044 Returns to DreamHack Dallas![/h3]

We’re heading back to DreamHack Dallas! Nexrage Studios is once again showcasing The Colony 2044 on the show floor. Last year, your feedback played a huge role in shaping the game as we pushed toward our Early Access launch. Now we're back and focused on the upcoming 1.0 release.

This time, we’re bringing even more updates, polish, and chaos from the wasteland. With the full release just a few months away, we’re eager to hear your thoughts and get your input one last time before launch.

If you’re at DreamHack, come say hi. We’d love to show you what we’ve been building!

[url=https://dreamhack.com/dallas/]DreamHack Dallas 2025[/url]

notes.title: 0.4.13.2 Hot Fix
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with tasks not loading correctly in non-home worlds.
[*] Fixed collider data on wheat causing them to not be collectable.
[*] Minimized blood splatters on bleeding colonists.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.4.13
notes.content:
We're super thankful for all the recent support and feedback we have received so far! In this update we've addressed the biggest issues our players were having, tweaked items to better balance gameplay, and added some new weapons and meals to arm and feed your colonists with.

[h3]Features Added[/h3]
[b]New Foods[/b]
[list]
[*] Carrot Cake
[*] Baked Sweet Potato
[/list]
[b]New Weapons[/b]
[list]
[*] Barbed Wire Bat
[*] Battle Axe
[*] Katana
[/list]
[h3]Tweaks and Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved colonist decision making when healing other colonists and themselves. [i]Colonists can now use bandages that are available in their inventory to heal themselves from bleed damage and heal other colonists when they are bleeding.[/i]
[*] Added clearer status icons above colonists nametags to help identify their needs
[/list]
[h3]Bugs Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Made changes to hauling to improve colonists behaviors when moving items to tasks
[*] Fixed serialization issues causing some games to not be saved properly and causing crashes
[*] Fixed issue with colonists getting stuck attempting to complete tasks that weren't available
[*] Fixed a memory leak issue with textures when generating the map causing crashes and lag
[/list]

notes.title: Audio Hot Fix
notes.content: Fixed an issue with duplicate sound effects triggering for certain tasks.

notes.title: Small Patch v0.4.12
notes.content:
[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Save slots now show the total time spent playing on that save.
[*] Added clearer areas for dragging items to drop, equip, and unequip.
[*] Added a quickslot bar for using equipped items.
[*] Added lettuce crop and removed wheat crop from farms.
[*] Recruiting new colonists now spawns them in the home world instead of the active world.
[/list]

[b]Bugs Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing multiple worlds to be generated on a first load. [i]This may fix crashing for some users when starting a new game.[/i]
[*] Fixed an issue with audio volumes resetting after returning to main menu.
[*] Fixed an issue with colonists not working after waking up and other various issues with tasks.
[*] Fixed aspect ratio in research menu to allow full navigation when unlocking new research.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the player HUD to disappear after saving a game.
[*] Fixed an issue allowing the player to travel before completing the tutorial quest.
[/list]

[b]Tweaks[/b]
[list]
[*] Tweaked the damage of melee weapons.
[*] Tweaked the damage of zombie bites.
[*] Tweaked the bleed, bandage, mending, and healing rates of the player and colonists.
[*] Tweaked the chance for colonists to spawn with certain traits.
[*] Reorganized the research menu unlock order.
[/list]

Have any suggestions?
[url=https://www.nexrage.com/discord style=button]Join us on Discord![/url]

notes.title: Small Patch v0.4.11
notes.content:
[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Colonist Status Icons to indicate condition or status changes.
[/list]
[b]Bugs Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with tooltips not appearing on construction menu items.
[*] Fixed an issue with research quests not completing.
[*] Fixed an issue with name tags disappearing.
[*] Tweaked loyalty settings and made small adjustments to skip job chance.
[*] Fixed an issue with Farm Plots displaying incorrect output value.
